description.text: Junior Level Chinese Schedule: Monday to Friday: 8:30-12:00 Major courses: Chinese phonetics, elementary intensive Chinese, methods of pronunciation, basic speaking and elementary listening comprehension. Middle level Chinese Schedule: Monday to Friday: 8:30-12:00 Major courses: middle intensive Chinese, reading, writing, speaking, grammar, tourism communication, middle level listening, and comprehension. Senior Level Chinese and Preparation for Professional Occupations Schedule: Monday to Friday: 8:30-12:00 Major courses: senior intensive Chinese, senior listening, general speaking, senior reading, grammar, writing Chinese, extensive reading, Chinese history and culture.

duration.text: The Chinese Courses at Beijing Union University, The Institute Of Tourism is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized

requirements.text: 1.Good Health 2.Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial deed of guardianship
